scope: Only temporary synthetic builder/calculator-valid archive and writer-produced one-record label stores. No actual s01 truth computed, no production store/archive/prefix/role input modified or read, no model/API/network.

strongest_counterexample.meaning: Record means/multiple/boolean/magnitude are internally coherent but contradict the untouched bound archive; polarity flips without any loader rejection.

proven_failures.finding: Load validates presence/version/count and local LabelRecord consistency, but never reads or hashes archive, recognizes calculator, checks contract, or recomputes the record. Missing/changed archive, wrong or malformed SHA, renamed calculator, changed or null label_contract all returned usable GroundTruth.

Record model validates dates parse/count/distinct and threshold/magnitude consistency only. It accepts multiple not equal to peak/baseline, baseline dates after cutoff, peak dates before cutoff, incorrect horizon end, and absent archive symbol. These must also be reconciled with actual canonical calculator output.

Coercion hides invalid schema: string false becomes bool true; numeric strings and bool values become numbers; True is accepted as both version1 and record_count1. Unknown record fields are ignored. This violates the existing strict-schema testing requirement, independent of source authentication.

owning_requirements.summary: Single canonical evaluation-only door; raw observation and derived values recomputed from frozen archive; manifest binds archive identity/SHA, calculator, contract/count and loading verifies them; changed vintage/calculator uses new store version; strict schema and derivation-equivalence tests.

minimum_contract_consistent_boundary: Before returning a verified store, validate recognized manifest version/types and semantic label_contract/calculator identity, locate the bound archive, hash its exact bytes and verify the required archive structure. Do not claim hash alone proves issuer or adjusted-price semantics.
Parse actual record types without truthiness/numeric-string coercion; preserve fail-closed duplicate/count/missing-key checks. Reject undeclared record fields under strict record schema.

For each record use the one owning six_month_smoothed_multiple calculator on its archive symbol and as_of_date; compare baseline/peak means and exact dates, horizon end, multiple, surge boolean and magnitude. Validate arithmetic and chronology as applicable; no independent duplicate calculator or hand-entered truth.

Keep existing canonical store and historical metrics unchanged. A rebuild against a changed archive/calculator must be explicitly versioned, with evaluation-side binding and no leakage into blind packets.
not_proven: This audit does not say any actual production/s01 label is wrong. Driver owns that original-material qualification and must report it separately.

Even a strict archive SHA and calculator reconciliation cannot alone authenticate the issuer-symbol mapping, provider adjustment basis or economic source correctness. Those require the existing source qualification evidence; no new absolute source-authentication claim is made.
No blind-agent Posthoc input or new model response was created. F10/general verified-loader qualification cannot be inferred from present load success.

reproduction.default: Loads frozen original_label_store.py.txt and original_outcomes.py.txt; requires a NEW --output file and refuses overwrite.
reproduction.new_reader_comparison: Pass --loader /absolute/path/to/current/label_store.py with a fresh output; frozen calculator may be selected separately via --calculator.
